# `mise bootstrap dotfiles history`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap dotfiles history [FLAGS] [SUBCOMMAND]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/dotfiles/history/mod.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/dotfiles/history/mod.rs)

Browse saved versions of your tracked files

A checkpoint is a saved version of every `[dotfiles]` entry with `mode = "track"`. `mise dot save`, the watcher, and every command that changes tracked files (such as `mise bootstrap`, `mise dot apply`, `rollback`, `pull`, and `undo`) record one. Checkpoints hold file contents only, not packages or services. Files deployed in other modes are saved only if you also track them. With no subcommand, lists checkpoints newest first.

See <https://mise.jdx.dev/dotfiles/history.html>

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`-n --limit <LIMIT>`** — Show at most this many checkpoints (0 for all)

  **Default:** `20`
- **`--path <PATH>`** — Only checkpoints where this path (or something under it) changed
- **`--trigger <TRIGGER>`** — Only checkpoints with this trigger, such as edit, save, agent, bootstrap, apply, rollback, or undo

  `bootstrap` covers `mise bootstrap`, its `packages` commands, and `mise dot add`, `apply`, `edit`, and `unapply`. `apply` covers incoming changes written by `mise dot pull` or the watcher.
- **`--label <LABEL>`** — Only checkpoints with this label
- **`--pending`** — Only checkpoints recorded by operations that did not finish
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

List recent checkpoints

```
mise dot history
```

List checkpoints that changed one file

```
mise dot history --path ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua
```

List the last five checkpoints from mise bootstrap or mise dot apply

```
mise dot history --trigger bootstrap -n 5
```

Show the newest checkpoint

```
mise dot history show latest
```

Show unsaved changes

```
mise dot history diff
```
